title: Login fails with correct password after password reset
description: Users who reset their password get an invalid credentials error when logging in with the new password.
resolution: Password hash was saved before the salt was regenerated. Reset flow now re-hashes with the new salt and clears the session cache.

title: Checkout returns 500 error when applying discount code
description: Applying any discount code at checkout shows a server error and the order cannot be completed.
resolution: Null reference when a coupon had no expiry date. Added a null check and default expiry handling; released as hotfix 2.3.1.

title: Monthly sales report shows wrong totals
description: Totals in the monthly sales report do not match the orders page. The difference seems to be refunded orders.
resolution: Report query included refunded orders. Added a filter to exclude orders with status refunded.

title: Add dark mode to the dashboard
description: Several customers have asked for a dark theme for the admin dashboard.
resolution: Implemented a theme toggle using CSS variables; released in version 2.5.

title: Product search is very slow
description: Searching the product catalogue takes 8 to 10 seconds for stores with large catalogues.
resolution: Added a full-text index on product name and description and cached results for five minutes. Search now returns in under 300 ms.

title: How do I regenerate my API key
description: A developer asked where to regenerate their API key after it was exposed.
resolution: API keys can be regenerated from Settings > Developer > Regenerate key. Added to the FAQ.

title: Card payments declined for all Visa cards
description: Since this morning every Visa transaction is declined. Mastercard payments still work.
resolution: The payment gateway certificate had expired. Renewed the certificate and added an expiry monitoring alert.

title: Session expires too quickly
description: Users are logged out after only five minutes of inactivity.
resolution: Session timeout in the production environment file was set to 5 minutes. Restored it to 30 minutes.

title: Export reports to Excel
description: The finance team wants to export reports as Excel files instead of copying tables manually.
resolution: Added XLSX export on the report page.

title: REST API returns 429 too often
description: Integration partners are hitting the rate limit at very low request volumes.
resolution: Rate limiter counted requests per IP behind the load balancer. Switched to per-API-key limits and fixed forwarded-IP handling.

title: Place order button text overlaps on mobile
description: The place order button text is cut off on small phone screens.
resolution: Fixed flex wrapping and minimum button width for screens narrower than 360px.

title: Dashboard takes a long time to load in the morning
description: The admin dashboard takes over 20 seconds to load at the start of the day.
resolution: Heavy aggregate queries ran on page load. Moved them to a nightly precomputed summary table.

title: Add two-factor authentication
description: Enterprise clients are asking for two-factor authentication for admin accounts.
resolution: Implemented optional TOTP two-factor authentication with authenticator apps.

title: Order confirmation emails not sent
description: Customers have not received order confirmation emails since yesterday.
resolution: SMTP credentials were rotated but not updated in configuration. Updated the secrets and added email failure alerts.

title: Customers charged twice when double clicking pay
description: A customer was charged twice after clicking the pay button twice quickly.
resolution: Added an idempotency key to payment requests and disabled the pay button after the first click.

title: API documentation missing pagination details
description: A partner asked how pagination works because the API docs do not explain it.
resolution: Updated the API documentation to describe the page and page_size parameters and Link headers.

title: Password reset link expires immediately
description: Users click the password reset link in the email and are told it has expired.
resolution: Token expiry compared UTC time to local server time. Normalised all timestamps to UTC.

title: Report date filter ignores end date
description: Filtering a report by date range excludes orders from the end date.
resolution: The end date was treated as exclusive. Changed the filter to include the whole end day.

title: Product images not loading after CDN migration
description: Product pages show broken image icons since the CDN migration.
resolution: Old image URLs were hardcoded to the previous CDN domain. Migrated stored URLs and added a rewrite rule.

title: Memory usage keeps growing on API server
description: The API server runs out of memory and restarts every few days.
resolution: A background job left database connections open. Wrapped connections in a context manager and set pool limits.

title: Schedule reports to be emailed weekly
description: Managers want reports emailed to them automatically every week.
resolution: Added scheduled report emails with weekly and monthly options.

title: Refund not reflecting in customer account
description: A refund was processed but the customer's balance did not change.
resolution: Payment gateway webhook failed signature verification after a secret rotation. Updated the webhook secret and added failure logging.

title: Account locked after one wrong password
description: Users are locked out after entering a wrong password only once.
resolution: Lockout threshold was misconfigured as 1. Set it to 5 attempts with a 15 minute cooldown.

title: Add webhook for order status changes
description: Partners want to be notified automatically when an order status changes.
resolution: Implemented an order.status_changed webhook with signing and retries.

title: Table columns misaligned in Safari
description: Report table columns are misaligned when viewed in Safari.
resolution: Worked around a Safari flexbox issue by switching the table layout to CSS grid.

title: Is there a limit on product variants
description: A store owner asked how many variants a single product can have.
resolution: Up to 100 variants per product. Documented in the help centre.

title: Entire site down with 502 Bad Gateway
description: All users see a 502 Bad Gateway error and the site is unreachable.
resolution: The application server crashed because the disk filled with log files. Cleared logs and enabled log rotation and disk alerts.

title: CSV product import fails with accented characters
description: Importing products whose names contain accented or non-English characters fails.
resolution: File was decoded as ASCII. Switched to UTF-8 decoding with BOM detection.

title: Add bulk discount pricing
description: Wholesale customers want lower prices when buying in large quantities.
resolution: Implemented tiered pricing rules in the discount engine.

title: SQL injection in search parameter
description: A security test found that the search parameter is vulnerable to SQL injection.
resolution: Replaced string-built SQL with a parameterised query and added input validation and a security regression test.

title: Update SSL certificate before expiry
description: The SSL certificate for the admin domain expires next month and needs renewing.
resolution: Renewed the certificate and switched to automatic renewal.

title: Upgrade database to supported version
description: The production database version reaches end of support this year.
resolution: Upgraded the database in a scheduled maintenance window after testing on staging.
